title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 26 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 26 February 2026 Mainly fair weather will prevail over most parts of the island. A few showers may occur in the coastal areas of the Western Province during the morning. Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Southern province and in Rathnapura and Monaragala districts after 2.00 p.m. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa, Western, North-western and North-central provinces and in Galle, Matara, Monaragala, Mannar and Vavuniya districts during the early hours of the morning.
